steps.title: Sketch the step profile
steps.command: 3D Model tab > Sketch panel > Start 2D Sketch
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt to start a new part.
Start 2D Sketch and click the XY Plane (the front).
Sketch tab > Create panel > Line: draw the six sided step outline from the origin.
Add the dimensions with Dimension (Sketch tab > Constrain panel): 60 long, 40 high overall, the step 30 long and 20 high. Click Finish Sketch.

steps.title: Extrude the block
actions: Click Extrude. The profile is picked for you.
Distance A: 40 mm, direction into the screen.

steps.title: Drill the 10 mm hole
actions: Click Hole and click the top face of the lower step.
Position the centre 15 from the left end and 20 from the front edge (half the depth).
Type: Simple Hole. Diameter 10 mm. Termination: Through All. Click OK.
